The Symposium

VYUHAM'26 is a national level technical symposium organised by the Department of MCA, K.L.N. College of Engineering — an autonomous, ISO 9001:2015 certified institution affiliated to Anna University, Chennai. For one day, our campus becomes a battlefield of ideas: coders debug under pressure, builders craft under deadline, hackers pitch under the clock, and quick thinkers compete in a lineup of sharp, high-energy non-technical games.

Whether you're here to hack, design, debug, or just outsmart the room — VYUHAM'26 is where you prove it. Assemble your team, pick your battles, and step into the arena.

Organised by — Department of MCA

The Battles Ahead

Choose Your Event

Three technical arenas. Four non-technical games. Pick your weapon.

Technical Events

Individual

Bug Hunt

Find and fix bugs in given code within a strict time limit — a solo race through syntax, logic, and runtime errors.

1 participant · Prelims 30 min · Main round 1 hr

Team

Web Craft

Build a webpage against a given brief, under the clock. Full brief and scoring details to be announced.

Details coming soon

Team · 1–2

SymHack

A themed hackathon. Build a hardware or software prototype around the given theme and defend it live in front of the judges.

8 min pitch + demo · 2 min Q&A · 10 min total

Non-Technical Events

Team

Onepiece

A treasure-hunt style team challenge. Full concept and rules to be announced.

Details coming soon

Team

BID 11

A cricket-auction style strategy game — build your dream XI on a budget. Full rules to be announced.

Details coming soon

Team · 3

Mindspark

"Three Senses" — a movie-guessing game of blocked senses. One acts (mouth closed), one relays (ears closed), one guesses (eyes closed). Pure teamwork under pressure.

3 members · 2 minutes per team

Individual / Team

As You Like It

A stage/performance-style game of quick thinking and expression. Full concept and rules to be announced.
